character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A colossal, invincible dark-crimson berserker orc with an immense hyper-muscular build, side view combat idle animation. Wild, messy, disheveled long white hair swaying slightly, chipped protruding lower tusks, and jagged facial scars. Left eye rhythmically blinking and pulsing with a menacing, flickering bright red light. A massive, prominent deep scar vividly carved dead center into the muscular chest, with heavy battle scars covering the entire dark-red physique. A powerful ethereal combat aura continuously billowing from behind the back, fluidly rippling and undulating like rolling waves in an active loop. A heavy rusted iron shackle locked strictly around the right ankle only, leaving the left leg completely bare; a short snapped iron chain trails from the right shackle, dragging slack along the ground. Massive scarred bare fists clenched and trembling with raw lethal power in a deep rhythmic breathing stance, projecting an overwhelming, undefeated presence, no held weapon. Clean bold outline, limited palette, chibi 3-head proportions.
